card.name: Study start date fields in trial records
card.fires_on: The year digits, table separators and spaces right after a "Study Start Date" or similar date label in clinical-trial registry entries. It also fires on the end of a date in other header-style lines.

modes.label: Trial start date
modes.description: Last digit of the year or the table bar after "Study Start Date" in a trial record.

modes.label: Other dated headers
modes.description: Spacing or year digit in a start/end or article date line on web pages.

card.writes: It suppresses age-related words like "old" and "age", so it steers the model away from age phrases after a date.
card.plain: It marks the spot just after a study start date in a trial listing, where an age word would not come next.
